newsitem.title: UK: UK's Hamlet has administrators called in.
newsitem.headline: UK's Hamlet has administrators called in.

text.p: British clothing supplier and retailer Hamlet Group Plc has gone into administration, with debts of 40 million stg, Coopers & Lybrand said on Tuesday.
Chris Hughes and Chris Barlow of Coopers & Lybrand and Keith Goodman of Leonard Curtis were today appointed joint administrators.
"We are actively completing a review of the businesses, which are trading as normal," Hughes said in a statement. "We have already had several expressions of interest for various parts of the group".
Share dealings in Hamlet were suspended last week.
